notices.support: Fail to furnish each buyer, at the time the buyer signs the door-to-door sales contract or otherwise agrees to buy goods or services from the seller, a completed form in duplicate, captioned "NOTICE OF CANCELLATION"
notices.summary_row: Door-to-door statement near signature, NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, oral notice, refund duties
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole statute section; besides the buyer statement and the NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form it holds operative rules (receipt contents, refund duties, assignment limits, property restoration) that should not print in the customer's contract

notices.support: A prescribed sentence for the risk of loss statement, the lien rights provision, or the bonding explanation | n/a | n/a | None exists in HRS 444-25.5 or HAR 16-77-80; the rule states what must be covered, not the words.
notices.summary_row: Contractor disclosure and written contract duties
notices.hold_reason: no prescribed wording; the statute only says the contract must contain the lien rights and bonding information, and the block is a whole statute section

notices.title: Chapter 672E defect notice in the contract (capital letters, conspicuous, part of the contract)
notices.support: 444-25.5(b)(2) requires the notice in every written home construction or improvement contract
notices.summary_row: Contractor Repair Act notice that must be in the contract
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole statute section; besides the capital-letter notice it holds subsection (a) on who must give it to whom and a history line, which should not print in the customer's contract

notices.format: Distinct capital letters next to the owner's signature line
notices.support: A clear statement of the risk of loss of any payments made to a sales representative (printed in distinct capital letters next to the owner's signature line)
notices.hold_reason: no prescribed wording; the rule only requires a clear statement of the risk of loss of payments made to a sales representative, in capitals beside the owner's signature line

changes.support: "Business day" means any calendar day, except Saturday, Sunday, or any state or federal holiday.
Fail to inform each buyer orally, at the time the buyer signs the contract or purchases the goods or services, of the buyer's right to cancel.
in the same language as that principally used in the oral sales presentation

changes.new: Saturday does not count as a business day. If the work needs a chapter 444 contractor license and the seller has none, the cancellation period is extended to thirty calendar days (HRS 481C-2.5).
changes.support: the cancellation period to be provided in section 481C-2 shall be extended to thirty calendar days

changes.new: Contractor license (exemption at $1,500 or less, not where a building permit is required); C-49 swimming pool contractor confirmed in the Board's Exhibit A; license number required in ads
changes.support: Pool classification C-49 is now confirmed from the Board's own Exhibit A

HAR 16-77-79 (seven disclosures before a binding contract) and HAR 16-77-80 (nine contract items) only list required content with no prescribed wording; no notice was added for them.
